title: Festive Ode to Yerevan
identity: Hartley’s Festive Ode to Yerevan is a 1998 work for alto saxophone and piano. The Hartley estate saxophone catalog lists it as catalog no. 227, publisher Dorn, duration 2:45, and accompaniment ‘Piano Duet’; the dissertation bibliography independently lists alto saxophone and piano. The source does not clarify whether ‘Piano Duet’ means piano four-hands or another scoring.

evidence.claim: University of Maryland saxophone dissertation bibliography lists Festive Ode to Yerevan for alto saxophone and piano, 1998.
Thematic catalog entry 248 (printed p. 156 / PDF p. 160) lists 1998 Festive Ode to Yerevan for alto saxophone, ‘piano duet.’ The catalog does not define that accompaniment label.
Official Hartley estate saxophone catalog lists Festive Ode to Yerevan as no. 227, 1998, alto saxophone, ‘Piano Duet,’ duration 2:45, publisher Dorn.
evidence.source_name: Walter S. Hartley estate, saxophone works catalog

evidence.claim: Dorn Publications catalog lists product DP1989 as alto saxophone and two pianos; relation of this abbreviation to the estate catalog’s ‘Piano Duet’ wording was not clarified.

collection_flag: Published saxophone work. The estate catalog calls the accompaniment ‘Piano Duet’ and the Dorn product catalog uses ‘a/2pno’; whether this is piano four-hands or two pianos is unresolved.
